cells.gaps: No figure gives the rural share, so the 116 of 116 that Smart Zambia stated in March 2026 cannot reach stage 5. That figure disagrees with later facts: Sinazongwe Town Council was reported as receiving its connection in August 2026 under a programme that still 'seeks to connect' all 116 councils, and North-Western Province's councils were announced connected in July 2026; the budget address of September 2025 counted 93 of 116. Use in a national system is not stated in so many words as done at the council office (the CDF system's data entry 'across councils', and a 2023 survey's e-procurement), and the financing is the plan's stated intention, not a budget line for council connections.
cells.note: More than half of the 116 councils are on the government's own network on a share whose source states the institutional connection, and on the lowest reading 93 of 116 still are. Stage 5 needs a figure giving the rural share and systems use stated at the office, and neither is held.
